count_scope: Actual events/signals and overlapping route counters retain their producer scopes; routes are not summed. Maintained physical fresh requests=refreshes+comparisons. Native/DR have no invented handler or maps counts. Scalar terminal rows do not replace independent full-state/retirement qualification. Certificate static plan proofs=publications+retirement_attempts, static rseq proofs=publications, certificate comparisons=2*entries and live rseq guards=3*entries. These are actual producer counts, not inferred speedups.
quantiles: inclusive linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; ten samples per complete measured lane/workload
scope: All82 required:40 ordinary unrolled-normal/certificate-reuse-normal, two certificate-reuse differential validations, then40 fresh native/DynamoRIO samples. Six same-revision/same-CPU qualifications (including all43 certificate owner cases and separate8 transaction cases) plus six actual-TU maps modes are prerequisites. Whole-profile comparison; no observer-only subtraction. CURRENT_TF is absent; its failed comparison remains failed.
sdk_scope: Existing exact DynamoRIO11.91.0 SDK and empty Release client. DR retains its original16GiB virtual-address allowance; other lanes retain512MiB. Earlier failed cohorts remain failed.
timing_scope: Actual pre-Popen through reap includes startup/reporting. No medians, IQR or ratios unless the entire82 and all closure gates pass. Differential and separate DR identity diagnostics have no timing credit. No fixed speed threshold.
